body:
ANIMATION CHAIN ENDED AS WIP. None of the three operator defects is closed. All task branches below are pushed. No production animation repair is claimed; the useful deliverables are the foot instrument/cause witness, pair diagnostics, and recovered v18 native guard candidate.

1) FLYFOOT2
Branch codex/flyfoot1; last commit f7b962b8.
Digest: research/FLYFOOT2_CHAIN_DIGEST.md.
Own matched master sample, Adebayo/Perez seed 94301: body05 lead raw ankle-ball max 41.373 deg, calibrated sole max 17.255 deg, literal-band outside 100%; body02 lead raw max 41.335 deg, sole max 14.889 deg, outside 100%. Only 5.99 seconds: not the required 2 seeds x 4 bodies x 60 seconds.
First writer: animation_sample; source silhouette rest maps a 39.179-degree ankle-ball anatomical slope onto MetaHuman rests of 24.224-29.270 degrees. No production retarget/IK fix was made.
Green instrument checks only: CHECK total=3 fails=0; synthetic probe SUITE total=1 fails=0. No animation red-to-green.
Open ruling: a physically flat MetaHuman sole already has a 24-29-degree ankle-ball segment, incompatible with the literal lead 0-12-degree band. Sole-calibrated versus literal metric question remains unanswered; thresholds were not changed.
Evidence: E:/FightCamp/tmp/flyfoot2/master_cast_94301.csv, red_current.csv, rest_anatomy.json, red_evidence.json. No new passing stills or 20-second candidate clip. Previously viewed E:/FightCamp/tmp/flyfoot1/delivery_stills/guard.png is historical, not new proof.

2) PAIRLIVE1
Branch codex/pairlive1; last commit 312533c9.
Digest: research/PAIRLIVE1_CHAIN_DIGEST.md.
No runtime red/green obtained. TOTAL=39 fails=5 remains your prior baseline, not a rerun by this chain. The initial census/original-test parse was CHECK total=2 fails=0; subsequent census edits and the new writer trace still need parse.
Read-only tools: Godot/tools/pairlive_census.gd and pairlive_trace.gd. Census uses named differentiated populations for seeds 930093 and 94301, counts sim actions and visible clip starts, separates ordinary as_game from explicit bench1 control. The recorder benchmark deliberately starts blue at stamina 28 versus red 95 and installs scripted events; the old 19/8 result cannot yet diagnose ordinary game output.
Static paths to trace: first-frame pair seek/advance and late _correct_refused_overlap push_hand calls. No speculative core fix was applied. Original baseline was queued repeatedly; after the 37-test TECHSTAGE1 batch, merged_solo_warp and merged_solo_face occupied the next slots. Only owned waiting wrappers were cancelled; no other job was interrupted. No queued chain job remains. An exclusive Godot slot is required.
No stills or clip for this item. All gates and production repairs remain open.

3) ANIMSOURCE1D
Branch codex/animsource1; last commit 7b71a3b3.
Digests: research/ANIMSOURCE1D_CHAIN_DIGEST.md and appended S222 section in ANIMSOURCE1D_DIGEST.md.
Fresh Blender calculations on retained, hash-verified rejected exports: FAIL FIX2_mesh body_hook; FAIL FIX2_facing body_hook; FAIL FIX2_wrist body_hook; FIX2_SUMMARY clips=22 red=22. These are not a new Godot export from today's merged runtime. All 22 current GLBs and both body blobs match the rejected baseline.
Hook: guard/contact chest gap 83.43/75.16 cm versus 78+/-4 / 52+/-2.5; max head yaw A/B 32.08/32.66 deg; lead wrist bend 64.47 deg; rear roll drift 43.13 deg. Body penetration bound zero: the mesh red is spacing/clearance, not a newly measured intersection. Receiver has exactly one native pose across 21 frames; exporter/fixture freeze guard_pose at time zero, so the required receiver reaction cannot be demonstrated by that path.
Recovered pre-existing v18 guard candidate is now committed, isolated from production: 544356 bytes, 341 joints, one animation, no render payload. Fresh primary gates on BOTH retained raw and imported exports: PASS FIX2_mesh/facing/wrist guard_pose; FIX2_SUMMARY clips=1 red=0. No new motion authored; hook and palette endpoints remain red. Native source hash, exact recipe/readback and all report hashes are preserved.
Old stills opened: E:/FightCamp/tmp/animsource1d/fix2_s218_guard_v18_game_raw/guard_pose_guard.png and .../fix2_s218_guard_v18_game_imported/guard_pose_guard.png. Both show differentiated men head-to-feet, separate bodies, cheek gloves, noses toward one another. Detailed gap/nose/wrist/foot export numbers and provenance limits are in the digest; the old PNG logs omit pair transform, so exact PNG-to-export matching is unverified. No new mid-hook stills or 20-second clip. Do not put these on the board as a fixed hook.
Evidence: E:/FightCamp/tmp/animchain_s222/baseline_audit.*, v18_raw.*, v18_imported.*. Peak observed temperature 82 C. No second Godot process was started. Preserved pre-existing import churn/reference copies in scoped stash 9f5a0efc0d8487e28970c3f950ab1be10e159c1d; no import churn committed, other candidates untouched, FighterCapsules untouched.

These were diagnostic/recovery passes, not three successful production repairs per item. Please retain all three defects OPEN. Required continuation: resolve the FLYFOOT metric, allocate an exclusive Godot slot for PAIRLIVE1, and author the full native two-body R50 hook before fresh full visual evidence and operator review.
topic: Animation chain WIP handoff - all three defects remain open
